features.definition: log1p(sum of observed accesses weighted by exp2(-token_age/4))
features.name: frequency_4

features.definition: log1p(sum of observed accesses weighted by exp2(-token_age/64))
features.name: frequency_64

features.definition: log1p(tokens since last observed access); zero when unobserved
features.name: token_recency

features.definition: log1p(last observed token reuse gap); zero before second access
features.name: last_gap

features.definition: log1p(reuse-gap EMA, new gap weight 0.25); first gap initializes EMA
features.name: mean_gap

features.definition: 1 after at least one post-snapshot access, otherwise 0
features.name: observed

features.definition: 1 after at least two post-snapshot accesses, otherwise 0
features.name: gap_known

holdout_policy: Frozen before fresh traces; evaluate only, no refitting or hyperparameter tuning

inference.admission: mandatory all selected experts; protect complete current route set
inference.budget: same exact expert-slot budget and initial residents as trace
inference.formula: score = intercept + sum(weights[i] * features[i]); evict lowest score
inference.history: bounded per-expert state, retained after eviction; reset on snapshot
inference.identifiers: no expert/layer ID or workload/phase feature
inference.label: future reuse within horizon_tokens; train inputs only, censored tail excluded
inference.tie_break: oldest last_used, ascending layer, ascending expert
